issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}'. Radix a11y warning — non-blocking but should be resolved by adding DialogDescription or aria-describedby to each DialogContent.

action_items: (Low priority) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ProfileDialog and other DialogContent instances to silence Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_refresh_lore uses len(docs) - last_msg_count freshness check, but last_msg_count is set to len(docs) which is capped at 30 (to_list(30)). Once past 30 total msgs, last_msg_count saturates at 30 and the delta will always be 0 → subsequent lore refreshes will short-circuit and never update. Consider using an absolute mongo count() or a monotonically increasing counter (e.g., max created_at) rather than the truncated to_list length.

server.py chat() rehydrates history from scoped_session and injects it verbatim into user context every call — for a long persona chat this bloats prompt tokens each turn (12 turns duplicated as text). LlmChat presumably has its own memory; the manual rehydration + LlmChat combo may double-count context.

prompts.py build_system_prompt does NOT truncate the lore block; user_traits/running_jokes/arcs come from LLM extraction and are already capped, but an unbounded system_prompt over many mode/character combinations is a token-cost concern.

LockIn.jsx computes progress as 1 - remaining/(minutes*60) but when user hits 'Reset' after stop() the plan is cleared — however remaining state and completed remain in prior values briefly; not user-facing but consider consolidating reset logic.

ProfileDialog draws canvas once on open; if user unlocks new milestones in a background tab before opening, stats reflect on open — fine. But there is no re-draw on prop change if `open` toggles false→true→false→true rapidly (setTimeout 50ms may leak). Minor.
